scope: Decouple large Rust crate roots and boundary files before continuing AstrBot platform/provider parity.
strategy: incremental, facade-preserving module splits; do not change public behavior in the first pass
ordering_rationale: Split runtime and provider first because new parity work currently lands there. Then split web/core/pipeline boundaries that feed dashboard and platform work.

must_preserve: Public re-exports remain compatible during first split pass.
Runtime, CLI, Dashboard, and HTTP layers must keep entering providers/platforms through registry and manager boundaries.
No provider/platform parity feature should be added in the same commit as a broad module split.
Each split must be validated by package-level tests before the next split starts.
